description: This file provides classes and functions for analyzing build statistics, including reading build stats from files, aggregating data, and comparing build stats and recipe versions.

classes.name: BSError
classes.description: Custom exception class for buildstats errors

classes.name: BSTask
classes.description: Represents a build task with timing and resource usage data

classes.name: BSTaskAggregate
classes.description: Aggregates multiple BSTask instances to compute mean values

classes.name: BSRecipe
classes.description: Represents build statistics for a single recipe, including tasks

classes.name: BuildStats
classes.description: Represents build statistics for an entire build, containing multiple recipes

classes.name: BSVerDiff
classes.description: Represents differences in recipe versions between two buildstats

methods.name: from_file
methods.description: Reads a buildstat text file and creates a BSTask instance

methods.name: from_json
methods.description: Creates a BuildStats object from a JSON object

methods.name: from_file_json
methods.description: Loads buildstats from a JSON file

methods.name: split_nevr
methods.description: Splits a recipe 'nevr' string into name, epoch, version, revision

methods.name: from_dir
methods.description: Loads buildstats from a directory containing build stats

methods.name: aggregate
methods.description: Aggregates another BuildStats object into this one

methods.name: diff_buildstats
methods.description: Compares tasks of two buildstats objects and returns differences
